notes.title: Going Free To Play!
notes.notes: Due to development availability, we will be hopefully making the game free for everyone, at least while it's still in early access, since we don't currently have the time to provide major updates!

notes.title: UI Update!
notes.notes:
We've started the update of our UI, including a new way to choose which arcade game you and your friends want to play.

Rebrand includes:
[list]
[*] Updated Logo
[*] Updated backgrounds and colors
[*] Updated game selection menu
[*] Updated backend functionality to eventually allow for up to 10 players (not set up yet)
[/list]

notes.title: We added instructions!
notes.notes:
We added an info screen to our first arcade game so you actually know how to play!
It's our first game release...y'all couldn't read our minds about how to play?? Sorry about that!

We have a lot more updates on the way, including visuals and more arcade games!
Keep giving us feedback and play Ricky's Rockin' Arcade at your next game night!
